query: WITH exhausted AS (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state='running' AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND attempts>=max_attempts ORDER BY lease_expires_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) UPDATE jobs SET state='failed',claim_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,finished_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp(),payload=CASE WHEN kind='webhook' THEN (payload-'token') #- '{event,data}' #- '{event,truncated}' ELSE payload-'token' END,last_error='lease expired at maximum attempts' FROM exhausted WHERE jobs.id=exhausted.id
